text.us: The justice department charges 28 green card holders in California over alleged voter fraud, its latest move against alleged noncitizen voting. Mahmoud Khalil asks the supreme court to review his deportation case, which could affect immigrants' right to challenge detention in federal court. Israeli police also detain 10 people in a rare raid on West Bank settlers, and France imposes partial curfews in several cities.
text.au: Politicians condemn an alleged attack that leaves independent MP Helen Haines critically injured, and Anthony Albanese says his thoughts are with her after police arrest a driver in Wangaratta. France announces curfews in parts of Paris, Nice and Lyon after days of violence. A banana shortage also hits supermarkets after cool weather in Queensland.

Zelenskyy says the US gave no warning of Russian strikes on Kyiv power plants and accuses Washington of a 'denial of reality'. A close aide to Reform leader Farage says his claim that £5m was a reward for Brexit was 'not press office line'.
